duplicate canonical runner lookup SQL remains in internal/core/runners.go.
role checks in internal/actors/node.go still use slice scans instead of set-based lookup.

blockedAssertions.blockedBy: successful auth.signup and auth.signin.password operations returned result:{}, and POST /api/v1/auth/session/exchange then failed 400 with "operation has no user result", blocking full authenticated status-code validation across endpoints.
